node.title: Re: Why am I getting "syntax error at Funcy.pl line 18, near "$barney return" ?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You're missing a semicolon on the line my $sum = $fred * $barney.

Update: Also, note that since [doc://return] will return from the sub, the if won't get executed. And I'm not sure why your if blocks only have one variable in them - if you're trying to return either one or the other value, don't use an if, use the [doc://perlop#Conditional-Operator] ?:, as in ( $fred > $barney ? $fred : $barney ).
